newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $0.50 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $0.50 - dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hogs Monday were seen steady to $0.50 per cwt lower on continued light packer demand and projections for increased hog movement, livestock dealers said.
Top prices for hogs delivered to the plant in Iowa and southern Minnesota could range $54.00 to $55.00 and Illinois top hog prices at the plant could range $52.50 to $53.00.
Indiana/Ohio top plant prices for hogs could span $53.00 to $53.50, the dealers said.
Packer buying has been light amid soft pork demand that has created unprofitable operating margins, they said.
Demand was expected to remain light as packers try to recover operating margins, which reportedly were $3.00 per cwt in the red, the dealers said.
The lower margins also could result in scaled back slaughter operations until margins improve, the dealers said.
Prices were expected to be pressured further by increased marketings early next week, they said.
Moderating temperatures this week allowed more hogs to recover weight lost by cold weather earlier in the month, the dealers said.
